svg.title: Chen ER: Standings and roster observations
svg.desc: Complete local Chen views for this domain. Every gray reference repeats the entity named on its numbered sheet. Relationships introduce FK columns during mapping; all stored scalar attributes and selected keys are shown. See relational-schema.md for the derivation, conditional participation and full relational constraints.

g.text: CHEN ER MODEL · 2/5 · Standings and roster observations
Rectangles: entities · diamonds: relationships · ovals: attributes · solid underline: chosen key
1/N give maximum ratios; double lines give mandatory participation. Gray boxes repeat an existing entity.
Entity and its stored scalar attributes
Entity and its stored scalar attributes
Entity and its stored scalar attributes
Double rectangle + double diamond: weak identification. Dashed underline: partial key. Dashed oval: derived.
club_id identifies a standings row only within its owner snapshot; goal_difference = goals_for − goals_against.
These local views join on repeated entity names. FK column groups, alternate keys and conditional rules: relational-schema.md.
Current diamonds map to shared-owner-key head relations. No multivalued attribute or extra entity is invented.
